title: Document the Agent Suite window (agent memory / tracker / custom-output viewer + AI-assisted rewrites)
description: Skill says: agents.md 'UI Location' (references/agents.md:226-228) documents only the 'Agents Panel (right sidebar -> sparkles icon)' plus the per-agent Agent Editor (references/agents.md:187 'The Agent Editor shows the agent's last run and output'); no mention of an Agent Suite. Reality (2.1): CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added (#3160) shipped 'the Agent Suite to the Chat Settings drawer's Agents section: a window listing the agents active in the current chat where you can view and edit everything they have stored - agent memory, tracker state, and custom-agent outputs - manually or with AI-assisted rewrites'. Confirmed in source packages/client/src/components/chat/AgentSuiteModal.tsx: active-agent selection (rail/dropdown ~1070-1090), agent-memory editable blocks (~1176-1217, Director memory hidden as 'Contains hidden narrative spoilers' ~1211), tracker-state slices Scene/Present Characters/Active Quests (TRACKER_SLICES ~159-217, editors ~1219-1264), custom-agent outputs (~1266-1299), and AI-assisted rewrite DataBlock (~581-885): select text or rewrite-all, give an instruction, 'Add Context' grounding picker for character cards / active-lorebook entries (~424-481,1331-1381, 'max 20 sources / 100,000 characters' ~1351), and pick a connection. It reads/writes the /api/agents/memory and /runs endpoints already listed at references/agents.md:222-224. Fix: add an 'Agent Suite' subsection under agents.md 'UI Location' describing this window (opened from the Chat Settings drawer -> Agents section), what it exposes (memory / tracker state / custom-agent outputs), and the manual-vs-AI-assisted rewrite flow with grounding context + connection selection.

title: Document the in-app Documentation viewer (home-footer button + FAQ docs-path entry)
description: Skill says: architecture.md never mentions an in-app docs viewer (references/architecture.md:171-181 'Special Features Worth Knowing' omits it); SKILL.md contributor 'Update affected docs' list (SKILL.md:249-256) treats docs/*.md purely as files to edit, not as content surfaced in-app. Reality (2.1): CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added (#3238) shipped 'an in-app documentation viewer: the guides shipped in the docs folder ... can now be browsed and read inside Marinara via a Documentation button in the home page footer next to Replay Tutorial, and a new ... FAQ entry that shows the on-disk docs path and opens the viewer'. Confirmed in docs/FAQ.md entry 'How do I read the documentation inside the app?' which states the guides are reachable 'From the home page footer' and 'also live on disk as regular markdown files in the docs folder inside your Marinara install folder'. Fix: add a bullet to architecture.md 'Special Features Worth Knowing' noting the Documentation viewer (home-footer 'Documentation' button beside 'Replay Tutorial' + FAQ entry showing the on-disk docs path), so ideation/support answers can point users to bundled docs in-app rather than only on disk.

title: Note xAI as a TTS provider option (skill has no TTS/voice provider coverage)
description: Skill says: architecture.md 'Providers Supported' (references/architecture.md:164-169) lists only LLM providers and image-gen providers; there is no TTS / text-to-speech / voice provider list anywhere in the skill (grep of the whole skill dir for TTS/voice/text-to-speech returns zero provider coverage). xAI at references/architecture.md:3,166 is documented only as an LLM (Grok) provider. Reality (2.1): CHANGELOG [2.1.0] Added 'xAI as a Text-to-Speech provider option with built-in voice fallbacks and xAI speech request handling'; source packages/shared/src/types/tts.ts:4 defines the TTS provider union as openai, elevenlabs, pockettts, xai (xai is TTS-specific and separate from the LLM 'xai' in packages/shared/src/constants/providers.ts:99-106). Fix: add a short TTS/voice-provider note to architecture.md 'Providers Supported' listing the TTS providers (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, PocketTTS, xAI) so the skill acknowledges TTS at all and reflects xAI's v2.1 addition; keep it distinct from the LLM provider list.
